# Pixel Street — full site text

> Pixel Street is a creative and digital agency in Salt Lake, Kolkata. It works across brand identity, web design and development, digital marketing and video production for FMCG, D2C, education, manufacturing and corporate clients in India and abroad.

Pixel Street was founded in 2020 in Kolkata, India, starting with a team of four focused on pixel-perfect website work. It moved into a custom-designed studio at Martin Burn Business Park in Salt Lake Sector V in 2022, broadened into a full advertising offer combining creative, media and technology in 2023, and has been rebuilding its practice around AI-assisted creative work since 2025.
The agency sells four service lines: branding and creative retainers, web design and eCommerce development, digital marketing and social campaigns, and video production. It publishes a 65-article blog on branding, web design, development, eCommerce, SEO and AI search optimisation.

## A Journey of Passion, Creativity, & Innovation.

## Expanding Services

Transitioning into a holistic advertising agency, we combined creative, media, and technology to serve our clients better.

We welcomed multiple MNCs and global partners, scaling up our team to meet the demands of an ever-expanding client portfolio.

## Branding - Creative Retainer In Kolkata

We develop timeless brands through strategy, design, and communication that resonates with the audience.

## Branding Agency For Bold Businesses

As a leading branding agency in Kolkata, we create the “wow” factor for businesses that want to stand out. We believe that a brand is more than a logo, tagline, product, or promise—it's the gut feeling about a product, service or organisation.

We develop your brand identity with strategic branding that just doesn’t grab attention but tells a story, evokes emotions, and builds a genuine connection with the audience.

Our suite of creative services further amplifies your brand's voice - bespoke stationery, packaging that tells a story, posters that captivate, and marketing collaterals that drive action — we ensure every touchpoint is a testament to your brand's essence.

Ready to make a mark? Partner with our branding agency and let’s craft an identity that's both human and unforgettable.

## How We Build Your Brand

A step-by-step process that takes your brand from strategy to a fully realised identity.

## Brand Strategy

We work out what the brand is for, who it is up against, and what it is allowed to say. Positioning, audience, tone and the messaging hierarchy, written down and agreed before anyone opens a design file.

## Visual Identity

Logo, type, colour, grid and art direction, built as a system rather than as a picture. You get guidelines specific enough that your team and your printer can apply the brand without coming back to ask us.

## Application

Where the identity meets the world: packaging, stationery, POSM, decks, the site, the campaign. This is the part that decides whether a brand survives contact with a deadline.

Pixel Street has been instrumental in helping us build powerful visuals for our brands. They have often gone out of the way to understand our ask and help us out even with tight deadlines. The team is well equipped to deal with all our packaging and POSM needs.

## FAQs

## What is branding and why does a company need it?

Branding is the process of creating a distinct identity for a business in the mind of your target audience that sell similar product or services. It is in not only your logo, font, colour palette, packaging but every touch point that a consumer interacts with. The goal of branding is to earn space in the minds of the target audience and become their preferred option for doing business.

## What makes your branding agency in Kolkata different?

As a branding agency, we always strive to dive deeper than surface-level aesthetics. While many focus merely on visuals, we prioritise understanding the core fundamentals of a brand. We don't just create brands; we build relationships between businesses and their consumers through - strategy, design, and messaging.

## What is included in your brand identity packages?

Our brand identity packages are three fold with the following deliverables:

- 1. Standard - Brand Strategy, Logo, Colour Palette, Typography, Brand Guidelines.
- 2. Advanced - Everything in Basic plus - Stationery & Brandbook Additional Add-Ons - Packaging, Website, Brochure, and other collaterals could be added.

## Can you list the creative services that you offer?

We work with companies to provide various creative services such as - Packaging, Poster, Marketing Collaterals, Email Newsletter, Photoshoot, eCommerce Artwork, Animation/Editing

## Do you write the copy for the creatives as well?

Yes, we do offer copywriting services for all the creatives we design. Our copywriters craft compelling content that not only complements the design but also effectively communicates your brand's message.

## Can you elaborate your timelines for different creative services?

The timelines for our creative services vary based on the project's complexity and scope:

- 1. Packaging: 1 week, depending on design intricacies and feedback rounds.
- 2. Poster: 2-4 days, factoring in the concept and design iterations.
- 3. Marketing Collaterals: Depends on type of collateral.
- 4. Email Newsletter: 1 - 3 days for design and HTML.
- 5. Photoshoot: About 1 week, including post-processing and edits.
- 6. eCommerce Artwork: 2-4 days, based on the product and complexity.
- 7. Animation/Editing: 1-4 weeks, considering the length of the animation and the intricacies involved.

## FAQs

## What does a web design company do?

A web design company is a team of designers and developers that work together to deliver unique websites. Pixel Street is the best web design company in Kolkata that integrates brand-centric UI with technical development to produce user-friendly and responsive websites

## What happens during web design consultation?

During our web consultation, we'll discuss about your web design goals, target audience, competition, and timeline for the project. Based on this conversation, we will provide you with a customised proposal and timeline for the project.

## How long will it take to complete my website?

We complete corporate websites usually within 20 working days. As for ecommerce websites, it depends on the number of products, pages and specific functionalities - usually it takes around 30 - 45 days to deliver.

## Do you offer custom designs or use pre-built templates?

We focus on creating custom websites tailored to your brand identity and requirements. We can use pre-built templates if required for faster turnaround times and lower budget projects.

## Will you maintain the website once it is delivered?

Absolutely! We offer Hosting + Maintenance support for all our websites at a fixed monthly fee. Our services include minor design changes, content updates, security, website updates, premium hosting, and SSL.

## Do you offer content writing services for websites?

Yes, we do. Our talented team of content writers create compelling, SEO-optimised content for your website. We work closely with you to understand your target audience, services and brand tone to ensure that the content is compelling.

## FAQs

## What is digital marketing?

Digital marketing a type of marketing that encompasses promotion of brands to connect with their target audience via internet or other forms of digital communication. This includes Social Media Marketing, SEO, Pay Per Click, Email Marketing, Content Marketing, Advertising, etc.

Digital marketing is essential for businesses in today’s world. If you want to get your brand/services in front of customers; your must be there where your customers are online.

## What services do your provide in digital marketing?

We provide holistic digital marketing services to our clients offering them a one-stop solution. Our services include Social Media Marketing, SEO and pay-per-click. The services are focused towards brand consideration, lead generation or sales.

## Which companies do you work with?

We work with a diverse range of industries - FMCG and Manufacturing to Healthcare and Jewellery. Whether you're a startup or an conglomerate, we're equipped to meet your digital marketing needs.

## What are your charges for digital marketing services in Kolkata?

The digital marketing plans that we offer are customised as per the client requirements as one-size doesn’t fit all. We can ensure that our pricing is affordable and delivers the best ROI. Please get in touch with our team for a custom quote.

## How long does it take to see results?

Digital marketing results can vary based on the channels that we use. Some methods, like PPC, yield immediate results, while others, such as SEO, may take months to show significant improvement. However, we provide regular updates and transparent KPI reporting, allowing you to monitor progress effectively.

## What KPI metrics do you track for your digital campaigns?

We track a variety of KPIs, including traffic, conversion rates, click-through rates (CTR), engagement metrics, return on ad spend (ROAS), and more. Our focus is always to provide efficient KPI monitoring and tracking.

## How do I find the right digital marketing company in Kolkata?

Choosing an agency from 100’s of options in Kolkata can be maddening process. Most of the agencies do not deliver on their promise and burn the organisations marketing budget. A good rule of thumb is to verify these details - proven track record, key clients, case studies, affordable pricing, testimonials.

## How can I collaborate with Pixel Street?

Collaborating with Pixel Street is simple! Drop us an email or give us a call, and our team will be happy to discuss your digital marketing requirements.

# Careers at Pixel Street

URL: https://pixelstreet.in/careers

## Careers at Pixel Street

## Life at Pixel Street

At Pixel Street, our office is more than just a space — it’s where ideas are born, collaborations flourish, and creativity thrives. Ready to be part of our journey? Let’s create something extraordinary together!

## Open Positions

## BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT HEAD

## Overview

We’re on the hunt for a Business Development Head who has real experience generating leads and closing deals for a creative or advertising agency.

You’ll be the force behind identifying new opportunities, building lasting client relationships, and driving consistent growth. No corporate fluff – just straightforward results.

## What You’ll Do

- Develop and execute practical, results-driven business strategies that cut through the noise.
- Utilise your network and established channels to source and nurture leads, ensuring a steady pipeline of opportunities.
- Connect authentically with clients and partners, building trust and fostering long-term collaborations.
- Draft proposals and manage the sales process from prospecting to closing.
- Collaborate with the founder and BD team on innovative strategies for expanding our client base.

## What You Bring

- 5+ years in business development in creative or advertising.
- Proven experience in generating leads and closing deals using established channels.
- Exceptional leadership and communication skills—clear, straightforward, and effective.
- A results-focused mindset with the ability to cut through complexity.

## BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER

## Overview

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager who’s all about identifying new opportunities and building the sales pipeline while keeping everything real and results-oriented.

## What You’ll Do

- Identify and pursue new business prospects that align with our agency’s focus.
- Interact with prospects genuinely, skipping the rehearsed scripts for honest conversation.
- Drive negotiations that secure mutually beneficial arrangements.
- Collaborate closely with our creative and tech groups to develop proposals that hit the mark.
- Maintain an organised sales pipeline and deliver clear, regular updates.

## What You Bring

- 3–5 years in business development or sales, ideally within a digital agency or startup setting.
- Sharp communication, presentation, and negotiation skills—straightforward and effective.
- A proven record of achieving or surpassing targets with a practical approach.
- Solid project management and time-management skills.

## ART DIRECTOR

## Overview

We’re looking for an Art Director who can set a clear visual direction for our projects and lead the creative team with practical expertise, not just artistic flair for its own sake.

## What You’ll Do

- Define the visual direction for the projects in a way that’s creative and results-driven.
- Guide a team of designers, offering candid feedback and actionable direction.
- Work hand-in-hand with copywriters, developers, and strategists to ensure designs add clear value.
- Oversee every step of the creative process, ensuring each project meets our high standards without overcomplicating things.
- Keep projects on track by balancing creative ambitions with deadlines and budgets.

## What You Bring

- 5+ years in art direction or senior design roles—experience in a digital or creative agency is ideal.
- A portfolio that demonstrates effective design solutions that solve real-world challenges.
- Proficiency in design tools (like Adobe Creative Suite) along with a practical understanding of both digital and print production.
- Well-versed with AI tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.
- Strong leadership skills that are honest, supportive, and results-oriented.

## SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER

## Overview

We are seeking a creative and enthusiastic Social Media Manager to join our awesome marketing team! If you are creative, innovative, and energetic, and if you love attracting people with your writing, we want you on our team!

## What You’ll Do

- Create and implement social media strategies that are clear, measurable, and true to our brand.
- Work with our creative team to produce engaging, well-crafted content that speaks to real people.
- Build & manage community interactions—responding to comments and building meaningful relationships without the usual hype.
- Use data to understand what’s working and pivot strategies as needed to maximise results.
- Keep current with what genuinely drives engagement on social platforms, rather than following every fad.

## What You Bring

- 3+ years of hands-on social media management, preferably in a digital agency or startup environment.
- Clear, practical communication skills with the ability to craft messages that cut through clutter.
- Strong analytical abilities to turn social data into actionable insights.
- A creative yet practical mindset for content that truly resonates.
- A Bachelor’s in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

## SR. WORDPRESS DEVELOPER

## Overview

We are seeking a Senior WordPress Developer to develop and manage custom WordPress & WooCommerce websites.

You will be responsible for back-end development, including developing WordPress themes and plugins.

## What You’ll Do

- Partner with design & content teams to create responsive, high-performance WordPress websites that deliver tangible results.
- Craft custom themes and plugins that meet client needs, without overengineering.
- Keep sites fast, secure, and easy to navigate through vigilant performance monitoring and practical optimisations.
- Mentor junior developers with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to best coding practices.
- Manage development projects to ensure timely, quality execution without unnecessary complications.

## What You Bring

- 4+ years of WordPress development experience, with a portfolio that reflects custom, efficient solutions.
- Proficiency in PHP, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Mysql, and version control (e.g., Git).
- A problem-solving attitude with a focus on practical, effective fixes.
- Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between the technical and creative teams.
- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred, but real-world experience counts most.

## COMPENSATION

- Fixed salary (25,000 - 30,000), including fixed pay and performance-based incentives.

## INTERN

## Overview

Pixel Street offers an immersive internship for those who are ready to learn by doing. You’ll get hands-on experience in a fast-paced, real-world environment, contributing to everything from day-to-day operations to creative projects.

This is a chance to roll up your sleeves and see how a digital agency works.

## What You’ll Do

- Assist departments with tasks ranging from business development, sales, design, to project support.
- Get involved in ongoing projects, shadow team members, and gradually take on more responsibilities.
- Help brainstorm and execute ideas across business development, design, social media, and web projects.
- Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and feedback loops to improve your skills and add genuine value.
- Help maintain project schedules, track progress, and support routine administrative tasks.

## What You Bring

- An eagerness to learn and a proactive attitude—this is about getting real experience.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- Basic proficiency in office tools (MS Office or Google Suite); familiarity with design or coding tools is a plus.
- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program related to Business, Marketing, IT, Design, or a similar field.

# Case study: Let The Craft Speak

URL: https://pixelstreet.in/case-studies/maison-ahmed

Client: ele without compromising the brand's minimalist elegance.The constraintCraftsmanship-led fashion brands face a particular tension online, the product is tactile, cultural and detailed, everything a screen struggles to convey, while the audience is scattered across markets that share neither a language nor a currency. The idea Let The Craft Speak, Let The Platform Get Out Of The Way.The interface was stripped back to near-nothing so nothing competed with the product photography, then the complexity, languages, currencies, customer support, was built in invisibly, underneath. Expression A minimalist WooCommerce build supported multiple languages, including English, French and Arabic, and multiple currencies, including MAD, EUR, USD, SAR and AED, for an international clientele, paired with an AI-powered multilingual chatbot giving non-English-speaking customers real-time support, and a streamlined backend simplifying inventory, orders and communication. What we did Minimalistic UI/UX DesignWe crafted a clean, minimalistic design for the WooCommerce website, emphasizing visual simplicity to highlight Maison Ahmed's luxurious products. The design uses high-quality images and elegant typography to convey the brand’s sophisticated aesthetic.Multilingual & Multi-Currency SupportUnderstanding the diverse customer base, the website was developed to support multiple languages, including English, French, Arabic, and the currencies MAD, EUR, USD, SAR, and AED. This ensures that shoppers from different regions can browse and shop with ease in their native language and currency.Custom WooCommerce IntegrationThe WooCommerce platform was customized to streamline the management of products, orders, and customer interactions, tailored specifically to the needs of a high-fashion retailer.Advanced Chatbot with AI TranslationWe integrated a sophisticated chatbot that uses Gen AI technology for real-time translation. This tool can converse with customers in multiple languages, answering queries about products.Mobile OptimizationThe website was developed in mobile-first approach with fast loading times and responsiveness across all platforms. “When the product is this considered, the website's only job is to stay out of its way.” Pixel Street · Creative team Impact Broader international reach, longer on-site engagement, and smoother day-to-day operations, all running through one platform built for a global customer. What it changed Enhanced Global ReachThe multilingual and multi-currency functionalities have effectively broadened Maison Ahmed’s market, attracting customers from various international locations.Increased Customer EngagementThe minimalist design and high usability of the website have led to increased customer engagement, with visitors spending more time exploring the collections and making purchases.Improved Customer SupportThe AI-powered chatbot has significantly improved customer support, providing instant assistance and enriching the shopping experience for non-English speakers.Streamlined OperationsThe custom WooCommerce setup allows for efficient management of the online store, simplifying processes like inventory management, order processing, and customer communications.This project highlighted the importance of combining aesthetic design with functional sophistication in creating an e-commerce platform for a luxury fashion brand.Maison Ahmed is well-positioned to cater to its upscale, global clientele while maintaining the brand’s heritage and luxury appeal. # Case study: Curating Impactful Digital Campaigns for Moroccan Atelier

URL: https://pixelstreet.in/case-studies/maison-digital-marketing

Client: s.Campaign Ideation & ManagementDeveloped and managed thematic campaigns highlighting the atelier's craftsmanship, such as the "Radiant White Harmony" kaftan series, to generate buzz and engagement.Content CreationProduced high-quality visuals and compelling narratives that showcased the intricate details of Maison Ahmed's designs, emphasizing their blend of tradition and modernity.Influencer CollaborationPartnered with fashion influencers to expand reach and credibility, featuring Maison Ahmed's pieces in diverse styles and settings.Analytics and OptimizationMonitored engagement metrics to assess campaign performance, allowing for data-driven adjustments to enhance effectiveness. “Luxury doesn't need volume. It needs proximity: get people close enough to the craft, and the rest follows.” Pixel Street · Creative team Impact A significant rise in followers and engagement across Maison Ahmed's platforms, wider brand recognition among an international audience, and a direct increase in inquiries. What it changed The strategic social media initiatives led to a significant increase in followers and engagement on Maison Ahmed's platforms. The visually appealing and culturally resonant content attracted a wider audience, enhancing brand recognition and contributing to increased inquiries and sales. This case underscores the importance of a cohesive digital marketing strategy in the luxury fashion sector. # Case study: Reimagining Web Design for Integrated Logistics Marketplace

URL: https://pixelstreet.in/case-studies/shipzip

Client: s to find the information they need.Custom IllustrationsTo vividly convey the dynamic nature of ShipZip's operations and services, we created custom illustrations that depict various aspects of the logistics process. These visuals help to break down complex logistics operations into understandable and relatable content.Blogs DevelopmentWe developed a dedicated blog section to educate visitors about logistics trends, tips, and the latest industry news, positioning ShipZip as a thought leader in the logistics space.Form to Google Sheet IntegrationWe integrated a system where form submissions are directly linked to a Google Sheet. This setup enhances the efficiency of customer service and sales follow-ups. “Nobody can photograph a supply chain. So we drew one they could actually understand.” Pixel Street · Creative team Impact An elevated brand image reflecting ShipZip's status as a tech-driven logistics leader, stronger engagement across trade and retail audiences, and a faster enquiry-to-follow-up pipeline for the sales team. What it changed Enhanced Brand IdentityThe refined brand guidelines and custom illustrations elevated ShipZip’s online image, reflecting its status as a tech-driven logistics leader.Improved User EngagementThe new UI/UX design led to an increase in website engagement, with visitors spending more time exploring the services and solutions offered.Effective Lead ManagementThe integration of forms with Google Sheets optimized the lead management process, enabling quicker response times and better customer interaction.Boost in SEO and Content ReachThe strategically developed blog section not only enhanced the website's SEO but also established ShipZip as an authority in the logistics sector, attracting more organic traffic.By combining user-centric design principles with technical functionality, we delivered a robust digital platform that not only meets the immediate needs of ShipZip but also supports its long-term vision of leading the logistics sector through technological advancement.
